_comment: Few-shot exemplar distilled from dbt-demo/models/chinook/{staging,intermediate,obt} and datapai-platform-be/dbt-traceability. Different domain from the target on purpose so the planner learns the SHAPE, not the answer.

models.name: stg_customer
models.description: One row per customer, typed and renamed from raw Customer.
models.logic: select and cast all columns; rename CamelCase to snake_case; no joins.

models.name: stg_invoice
models.logic: typed passthrough; cast invoice_date to date.

models.name: stg_invoice_line
models.description: One row per invoice line item.

models.name: int_invoice_line_priced
models.description: Invoice lines enriched with header date and customer, line_amount computed.
models.logic: join stg_invoice_line to stg_invoice on invoice_id; line_amount = unit_price * quantity.

models.name: dim_customer
models.logic: surrogate key = dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key(['customer_id']); keep descriptive attributes only.

models.name: dim_date
models.description: Calendar dimension spanning the invoice date range.
models.logic: generate one row per calendar day between min and max invoice_date using a recursive CTE or generator; add day/week/month/quarter/year attributes.

models.name: fct_invoice_line
models.description: Transaction-grain fact: one row per invoice line with FKs to customer and date.
models.logic: left join int_invoice_line_priced to dim_customer on customer_id and dim_date on invoice_date; expose keys + measures.

notes: Staging reads sources only; intermediate/dims/facts read refs only; facts reference dims by surrogate key.
